sloka: वरुणश्चग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयम् प्रदिशन्तु ते ।गता भगवती रात्रिरः शिवमुपस्थितम् ॥२-१५-२३॥
transliteration: varuṇaścagnirindraśca vijayam pradiśantu te ।gatā bhagavatī rātriraḥ śivamupasthitam ॥2-15-23॥

translations.english: The holy night has passed and the auspicious day has arrived. O tiger among kings, awaken and attend to your duties.
